sampling: Deterministic seeded sample of non-Wikipedia, non-proper-name database stem surfaces plus clitic combinations, reanalyzed for complete teacher ambiguity. This is teacher-sampled, not a natural text corpus.
splitPolicy: Connected components of all lemma families sharing ambiguous surfaces; 75/10/5/10 hash buckets. Example-connected families forced into verification. Final test sealed until release-candidate evaluation.
